title: thymus serpyllum var. glabrescens
intro: Thymus serpyllum var. glabrescens, commonly known as wild thyme, is a perennial herb that belongs to the mint family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of wild thyme include its ability to soothe digestive issues, relieve respiratory problems, and calm nervous system imbalances. The bioactive constituents of wild thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
